parts.text: 3 A student investigates the reaction of magnesium with dilute sulfuric acid.

parts.label: a
parts.text: (a) Complete the word equation for the reaction of magnesium with dilute sulfuric acid. magnesium sulfuric acid ....................... ....................... hydrogen + + [1]

parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) The student sets up an experiment to investigate the rate of this chemical reaction. The student: • carries out the experiment at 25 °C using 2.00 g of magnesium ribbon and 25 cm 3 of dilute sulfuric acid • measures the total volume of gas produced at regular time intervals • plots a graph of the results. Fig. 3.1 shows the graph of the student’s results. Fig. 3.1

parts.label: iv
parts.text: (iv) The experiment is repeated at a higher temperature. All other conditions stay the same. Draw a line on the grid in Fig. 3.1 to show how the volume of hydrogen gas produced changes at a higher temperature. [3]
